title: OpenAI Begins Visual Ad Testing in ChatGPT Image Generation
summary:
Initial US-based campaigns will appear within the chatbot's creative tools later this month for a select set of users. OpenAI will display clearly labeled visual ads while people generate images, deploying the new format to a limited group of advertisers as part of a regional test.

The company is collaborating with Haus, Measured and WorkMagic to evaluate the effectiveness of the advertisements. Parallel efforts to ensure the placements align with corporate standards are being conducted through partnerships with DoubleVerify and Integral Ad Science for brand-suitability testing.

OPENAI INTRODUCES NEW VISUAL ADS IN CHATGPT

OpenAI is introducing a new visual advertising format in ChatGPT, with U.S. testing beginning later this month among an initial group of advertisers.

The format will initially appear during image generation.

OpenAI is also partnering with Haus, Measured and WorkMagic on ad-effectiveness experiments, while working with DoubleVerify and Integral Ad Science on brand-suitability testing.
